blurb: Guests play paintball using biodegradable, eco-friendly paintballs in various game styles including woodsball, scenario, X-Ball, and speedball. The park offers extensive safety briefings and certified referees to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience. Reservations are recommended and a waiver is required for players under 18.
extraNote: $50 deposit required to secure private group booking · Reservations recommended at least 1 week in advance · No outside paintballs allowed, field paint only · Alcohol not allowed except in private parties
